observed_evidence.required_checks: exact head 4dc017e0b709d1c7db060f97db44cda0d76f58b6 action_required with zero started jobs; not green

root_cause: Publisher accepted a focus keyword ending with a preposition, treated the full section block as FAQ heading and reused a future-tense opening date after that date had passed.
prevention_rules: Choose two substantive subject words when an editorial verb+preposition is presented as a focus term.
Emit only source-authored FAQ questions, parse heading first line, reject invented or empty FAQ structured data.
Reject already-passed absolute future event-opening claims; demand upstream source review rather than silent rewriting.
Do not merge or claim provider delivery while Required and CodeQL have action_required with no jobs; exact-head controls and independent production readback remain mandatory.
Keep the existing canonical writer and publisher, ONE BRAIN ledger, and no duplicate schedules or campaign actions.
terminal_rule: Source tests pass, exact-head Required + CodeQL pass, protected merge, following genuine blog candidate quality pass, exact Netlify canonical readback, downstream views/leads/orders observed rather than predicted.
